name: d59zqv-provider-credential-issuance
goal: Prove both approved provider issuance flows validate scope and origin, deliver only to the private store, and return metadata only in a dummy end-to-end canary.

evidence: 4n1chc, tm6ynf and jw0799 pin the project, app, scope and destinations. OpenAI uses the published Admin API with the documented model request scope for the demo Realtime WebSocket. Slack uses the official OAuth exchange and the existing identity and Vault writer. Test dummy issuance and storage on harbor-mbp-2. Live broker inputs remain required.
Added trusted stdin-only OpenAI and Slack issuer scripts with fixed HTTPS origins, direct private stores, duplicate checks and metadata-only receipts. No live provider credentials were provided.

On harbor-mbp-2, /usr/bin/python3 -B -m unittest discover -s deploy/vault -p *_test.py passed all 22 cases. Both stdin-to-store canaries verify mode 0600, scoped provider requests and metadata-only output. Redirects, wrong targets and an existing sink fail closed. Repeat on the committed revision.
